name: Vorinclex
description: Vorinclex is a Phyrexian praetor, a twelve-foot warrior whose empire is based on the Hunter Maze.

bio.text: He joined Elesh Norn's effort to create Atraxa.

On Kaldheim he attacked and mortally wounded the goddess Esika in the World Tree's sanctum, told her she lacked the hunger and fear to survive, took a sample of the tree's sap, and returned through a red portal.
